services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: Experience Chicago's iconic waters your way with unlimited access to a professionally maintained fleet of premium vessels. We take care of the cleaning, maintenance, trailering and winterization, so you can enjoy the best of boating, without the hassles of ownership. Carefree Boat Club Chicago offers three unique ways to experience the city from the water. From 31st Street Harbor near Soldier Field to Belmont Harbor in Lincoln Park, with Burnham Harbor in between, each spot provides unbeatable skyline views, easy lakefront cruising, and front-row access to all the best of Chicago summers.
